before: An accepted strike of a note's text drew the note's last paragraph mark away even while another reference still cited the note: compose wrote an empty note, or, with a pending move inside the note, refused the room's file after the decision applied.
after: A note's last paragraph mark draws when a decision took it away, with what still shows in it, as the engine keeps a story's last paragraph.
reason: Change messages, the change log, checkpoints and the Yjs format do not change; compose writes the same file on every copy. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
